definitions.gloss: to repent, to reform oneself, to mend one's ways
definitions.explanation: To deeply regret past wrongdoing and resolve to change one's behavior. Carries a moral and sometimes religious weight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{過|あやま}ち→過ち：14376_ayamachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{悔|く}い{改|あらた}める。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行|おこな}い→行い：14121_okonai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{悔|く}い{改|あらた}め、⟦{真面目|まじめ}→真面目：01206_majime⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{誓|ちか}った→誓う：00030_chikau⟧。
examples.english: He repented of his actions and vowed to live honestly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{悔|く}い{改|あらた}めなければ、⟦{許|ゆる}される→許す：02325_yurusu⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Unless you repent of your sins, you will not be forgiven.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{悔|く}いる→悔いる：25247_kuiru⟧ (to regret) + ⟦{改|あらた}める→改める：12923_aratameru⟧ (to reform). The combination emphasizes not just feeling regret but actively changing one's conduct. Common in religious, moral, and literary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{悔|く}い{改|あらた}める: to repent of one's sins
- ⟦{過|あやま}ち→過ち：14376_ayamachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{悔|く}い{改|あらた}める: to repent of one's mistakes
- ⟦{行|おこな}い→行い：14121_okonai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{悔|く}い{改|あらた}める: to reform one's behavior

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to regret — focuses on the feeling of regret without implying reform
- ⟦{反省|はんせい}する→反省する：21398_hanseisuru⟧: to reflect on one's actions — more everyday; implies self-examination
- ⟦{改心|かいしん}する→改心する：25543_kaishinsuru⟧: to have a change of heart — focuses on the inner transformation
